method: Explicit-vocabulary TF-IDF features and linear ridge heads; independent control masks current-state features, conditional arm includes current-state text/count/interactions. Shared projection/weights are portable JSON; no runtime selector integration yet.

training_inputs.labels: Original reviewed actual Reader outcomes, nulls omitted; equal total weight per question/head. Multiple subsets and equivalent aliases remain dependent.

costs.training_timing_limit: Initial full-fit common vocabulary construction was not timed separately; arm timings are not the complete training wall time. Later runner adds total timing. Original result is preserved.
costs.existing_teacher_cost: Two prior outcome runs paid 24 generation calls/120236 tokens total; already recorded in the continuous ledger, not charged again.

validation: Actual full fitting and two excluded-question folds completed
finding: Conditioning improves fit on the two training questions and distinguishes a fixed candidate at empty versus complementary evidence. Across the two excluded-question folds, immediate-gain MSE is worse (0.2369 versus0.1800); two-open and answer-return MSE are lower. This mixed two-query result does not establish a useful selector or semantic generalization.
limits: Both questions were already exposed during development; excluded-fold vocabulary and coefficients are trained only on the other question, but this is not global formal holdout.
Only oracle-nominated subsets have outcome labels. No actual full-pool action trajectory, stop decision or selected-subset Reader quality has been measured for these weights.
Scores are uncalibrated, unpenalized observed-return estimates; cost/opens remain explicit. The lexical control is not an LLM or claimed new architecture.
Equal coefficient-vector dimensions are not equal effective capacity: state feature blocks are identically zero in the independent control.
next: Review the queued ten-question actual outcomes, expand clean supervised cases, and compare a trained conditional policy through the same real Source/Reader path with strong simple controls; retain this cross-query failure.
